localStory.text: The R Street restaurant is the original Iron Horse Tavern and MAC calls it its flagship.
Its R Street setting occupies the revived former railway corridor; the interior references the locomotives that traveled there.
The R Street venue has an indoor fireplace and patio.
The Folsom location sits in Palladio and has an outdoor patio.
MAC Hospitality Group is family-owned and reports more than 30 years serving Sacramento and Folsom.
